2.284.8
CustomReportItem.DataElementName
The CustomReportItem.DataElementName is an optional element that SHOULD be ignored and
that MUST NOT be specified more than once. If this element is present, its value MUST be a String
([XMLSCHEMA2/2] section 3.2.1) that is a CLS-compliant identifier [UTR15] that is unique within
the same data element hierarchy.
Following is the parent element of the CustomReportItem.DataElementName element.
Parent elements
CustomReportItem
The following is the XML Schema definition of the CustomReportItem.DataElementName element.
 <xsd:element name="DataElementName" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0" />
